dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 30, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
Rays' Late Rally Stuns Rangers, Twins Edge Royals in Extras

In a thrilling night of MLB action, the Tampa Bay Rays came from behind to defeat the Texas Rangers 3-2, with Cedric Mullins hitting his 13th home run of the season. Yandy Díaz also contributed with a strong performance at the plate, while Steven Matz impressed on the mound, striking out three in two scoreless innings. Garrett Cleavinger earned the win in relief.

Meanwhile, the Minnesota Twins edged the Kansas City Royals 4-3 in extra innings, thanks in part to Kody Clemens' grand slam in the top of the 10th. Noah Cameron pitched a stellar eight innings for the Twins, allowing just one hit and striking out seven. Yoendrys Gómez earned the win in relief.

The Chicago White Sox took down the New York Yankees 2-1, with Sean Burke dealing six shutout innings and striking out 10. Trent Grisham had a strong game at the plate for the Yankees, but it wasn't enough to overcome the White Sox' strong pitching performance.

In other results, the Chicago Cubs defeated the St. Louis Cardinals 4-2, with Javier Assad pitching four strong innings and striking out six. The Cincinnati Reds edged the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, with Yohan Ramírez pitching two scoreless innings and striking out four.

The San Francisco Giants took down the San Diego Padres 4-1, with Robbie Ray pitching six strong innings and striking out six. The Boston Red Sox edged the Athletics 5-4, with Willson Contreras hitting a crucial home run in the top of the 9th.

The Los Angeles Dodgers dominated the Seattle Mariners 6-2, with Roki Sasaki pitching 5.1 strong innings and striking out seven.
